d43: That night, they bring Wei home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.

lines: d42: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Wei Stepanov is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d42: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d42: 🕯️ Wei Stepanov is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d42: What Wei kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d42: "Wei's gone." Volker looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Wei." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d42: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Ruben blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Wiring & Circuits (Level 1). Volts, amps, and why you respect both. Safe splices, real grounds, no shortcuts.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d42: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d42: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d42: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Wei Stepanov, 42 days. The mantle passes to Ruben Feldman.
d42: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Ruben Feldman, 49 — an appliance repair tech. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper.
d42: The village's quarrel was with Wei — and Wei is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d42: At the grave, Jordan, Volker, Beletu and 3 more speak for Ruben — "Wei trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d42: The fire knew Ruben before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

lastSay: d111: ◈ The System names Volker: Berserker of the One-Person Army. The village repeats it at the fire.
d111: ◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Volker — Combat 3. Three offers; they took Cornered Rat, letting go of Beast-calm. Earned, chosen. (cornered_rat: villager level-up)
d111: 📓 Codex: Volker chose Cornered Rat (cornered_rat) at Combat 3.
d111: 🏆 The Company did that. Not one hero — the whole shape of them, moving together. The village will hear this one with the name attached.
